summary: First-pass full test of LiquidAudio (Expo + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass across discovery, stream proxy, lyrics and library flows. Frontend (mobile 390x844): home + genre chip filter, hero play, mini-player, search + play, player controls (play/pause/next/prev/favorite/lyrics), lyrics screen, equalizer (enable/preset/effect), library segments + theme toggle, and track-actions modal (favorite/create playlist/add-to-playlist) all work end-to-end. Two React Native Web deprecation warnings and an intermittent 502 on stream proxy detected but non-blocking. No deprecated Expo modules (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) found. No SafeAreaView issues detected.

minor.issue: Intermittent upstream 502 for some Audius tracks; backend correctly logs and returns 502, but occurs occasionally in normal browsing. Consider retrying across all resolved hosts on non-2xx (currently continues only on exception or 4xx+, which is fine, but adding a small internal retry may improve UX).

issues: Deprecated React Native Web warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents' (use style.pointerEvents). Cosmetic only, but they spam the console.

action_items: Optional: migrate remaining 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents' to 'style.pointerEvents' to silence RNW deprecation warnings.
Optional: on stream proxy, retry across all resolved Audius hosts on any non-2xx status (not just on exceptions) to reduce intermittent 502s.
Track-actions modal opens with a slide-up animation; consider ensuring initial layout is in-viewport immediately (or exposing an 'open' state prop) so automated tests don't need extra waits.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via projection {'_id': 0} — good.
All routes properly namespaced under /api — good.
server.py uses env vars for MONGO_URL and DB_NAME without defaults — good (fails fast).
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for API calls — verified via api.ts.
All interactive components have testID attributes across screens and components — good coverage.
seed_data_creation: Created device_id='test_device_1' library with a favorite (added+removed), a recent play, and playlist 'TEST_Playlist_1' during pytest run. UI test also created a 'TEST_UI_Playlist' in the same device library.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_liquidaudio.py for regression. BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (falls back to preview URL). Test device_id is 'test_device_1'. For UI tests, use mobile viewport 390x844 and add >=600ms wait after opening track-actions modal (slide-up animation).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. The initial Playwright failure on the track-actions modal was a timing race with the slide-up animation, resolved by adding a short wait and confirmed working via subsequent run (toast 'Added to Favorites' verified).
